narrative: The tables, a short fact, and a rule under it. No face. Three reasons written under the rule, none of them marked. No face. A last line, apart from the reasons. The canvas is not in the room. No face.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Wrote the fact apart from the reasons, and left them unchosen.

entities.name: the Rose
entities.context: Shown on tables in Reasons unchosen
